presets.title: Quick start
presets.note: Room layouts and sizes are estimates for a typical floor plan. Replace them with measured values for accuracy. (24 pyeong ≈ 59㎡ net, 32 pyeong ≈ 84㎡ net)

interiorCalc.pyeongNote: When entering pyeong, the wall perimeter is estimated assuming a 1.25:1 rectangle.

paper.specNote: Typical sizes (vary by product): silk 1.06×15.6m, wide paper 0.93×17.75m — each roll covers about 16.5㎡ of wall. Narrow paper 0.53×12.5m.
paper.repeatHelp: With a pattern repeat, each drop is cut in repeat units to match the pattern, so more rolls are needed. Use 0 for plain paper. Drop length = ceiling height + 10cm trim.

paint.coverageHelp: Interior water-based paint covers about 8–12㎡ per liter per coat. Check the label.
paint.canNote: With all 18L/4L/1L prices entered, the cheapest combo is chosen; otherwise larger cans are assumed cheaper per liter and the least-waste combo is picked.

floor.lamNote: A box typically covers about 1 pyeong (3.3㎡). Check the box label.
floor.vinylNote: Usually 1.8m (1.83m) wide, some 2m. Sold by the running meter. The cheaper direction is used with 10cm extra per strip.

tile.note: Use 10%+ for small bathrooms or large tiles with many cuts, about 5% for large plain floors. Tiles per box are sample values and vary by product.

trim.note: Baseboard = room perimeter minus door widths; crown molding = ceiling perimeter. Tiled-wall rooms (bathrooms) are excluded; 10% extra for cuts.

hero.label: Materials for {n} rooms · {py} pyeong floor
hero.partial: Only materials with prices are included
hero.noPrice: Enter material prices to get the total cost

interiorCalc.invalidRoll: A wallpaper drop (height + trim + pattern repeat) is longer than the roll. Check the roll size or ceiling height.
guideLimitItems: Wallpaper drops = net wall area ÷ (roll width × height), then divided by drops per roll. Short pieces above doors/windows are assumed to come from offcuts.
Rolls are assumed to carry over between rooms (summed, then rounded up). Opening a new roll per room needs a bit more.
Ceiling wallpaper is assumed to run across the short side without pattern matching.
Sizes, coverage and box counts are typical values. Check product labels and contractor quotes before buying.
Entryway, hallway, balcony and closet interiors are not included — add them as rooms if needed.
interiorCalc.title: Interior Area Calculator
interiorCalc.description: Enter room dimensions or pyeong to get wallpaper rolls, paint cans, laminate boxes, vinyl meters, tile counts, baseboards and total material cost. Supports door/window deductions, pattern repeat, waste rates and whole-home totals.
interiorCalc.customDeductionHelp: Built-in closets, feature walls, etc. not being papered
interiorCalc.noRooms: Add a room to get started
guideBasicItems: Pick a quick-start layout (studio, 24- or 32-pyeong apartment), then open each room to enter measured sizes.
For each room enter W × L or pyeong, ceiling height (typically 2.3m in Korean apartments), and door/window counts and sizes.
Choose wall/floor/ceiling finishes per room; materials are totaled for the whole home.
Enter prices to get the total cost, then copy the shopping list or share a link.
guideMaterialItems: Silk and wide paper rolls nominally cover about 16.5㎡ of wall, but cutting drops wastes some, so you need more than area alone suggests.
Paint liters = area × coats ÷ coverage. Two coats is typical; buy a mix of 18L, 4L and 1L cans.
Laminate is sold by the box (≈3.3㎡), vinyl sheet by the meter from 1.8m-wide rolls.
Tiles = area × (1 + waste) ÷ (tile + grout) area. Waste is usually 5–10%.
